component.name: BitChat
component.summary: Terminal peer-to-peer chat client over Bluetooth Low Energy and LAN

description.p: BitChat is a decentralized, end-to-end encrypted terminal chat application designed for resilient local communication over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Local Area Networks (LAN) without requiring internet connectivity or servers.

ul.li: Decentralized peer discovery over BLE advertisements and UDP broadcast
End-to-end encryption utilizing the Noise Protocol Framework (Noise XX handshake)
Multi-hop mesh message routing and automatic fragment reassembly
Interactive terminal user interface powered by Textual
Dual-stack BLE and LAN transport with automatic network loss recovery

description.p: Production release introducing native Linux packaging, LAN transport, and system diagnostics.
